LanguageData.HE_Yamato_BS_Ashigaru.title: ashigaru footman
LanguageData.HE_Yamato_BS_Ashigaru.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was a farmer's son until the clan drums called. [PAWN_pronoun] learned to hold a spear in a tight line and to dig in fast when arrows began to fall.
LanguageData.HE_Yamato_BS_Swordsmith.title: swordsmith
LanguageData.HE_Yamato_BS_Swordsmith.description: For twenty winters [PAWN_nameDef] folded and hammered tamahagane in a mountain forge. [PAWN_pronoun] would rather break a flawed blade than let it leave the workshop.
LanguageData.HE_Yamato_BS_Ronin.title: masterless samurai
LanguageData.HE_Yamato_BS_Ronin.description: When [PAWN_possessive] lord fell, [PAWN_nameDef] chose wandering over a shameful death. [PAWN_pronoun] sold [PAWN_possessive] sword to whoever paid and learned that honour does not fill a rice bowl.
LanguageData.HE_Yamato_BS_Monk.title: temple monk
LanguageData.HE_Yamato_BS_Monk.description: [PAWN_nameDef] swept the stone steps of a mountain temple for years, tended its herb garden and nursed travellers who arrived sick. [PAWN_pronoun] will not raise a hand in violence.
LanguageData.HE_Yamato_BS_TeaMaster.title: tea master
LanguageData.HE_Yamato_BS_TeaMaster.description: [PAWN_nameDef] served tea to lords and generals and listened to everything they said over the cups. A quiet word from [PAWN_objective] has settled more feuds than any sword.
LanguageData.HE_Yamato_BS_RiceFarmer.title: rice farmer
LanguageData.HE_Yamato_BS_RiceFarmer.description: [PAWN_nameDef] spent every spring knee-deep in flooded paddies, planting seedlings one by one. [PAWN_pronoun] can read the weather in the colour of the morning sky.
LanguageData.HE_Yamato_BS_Hatamoto.title: shogun's bannerman
LanguageData.HE_Yamato_BS_Hatamoto.description: [PAWN_nameDef] stood beside the shogun's banner in three great battles and never stepped back. [PAWN_pronoun] commands with few words and expects them to be obeyed at once.
LanguageData.HE_Yamato_BS_Akindo.title: port merchant
LanguageData.HE_Yamato_BS_Akindo.description: [PAWN_nameDef] bought silk, sake and lacquerware at the harbour and sold them inland at twice the price. [PAWN_pronoun] bows deeply and counts quickly.
LanguageData.HE_Yamato_BS_DojoChild.title: dojo pupil
LanguageData.HE_Yamato_BS_DojoChild.description: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up sweeping the floor of a sword school and practising cuts on straw bundles until [PAWN_possessive] arms ached.
LanguageData.HE_Yamato_BS_TempleChild.title: temple novice
LanguageData.HE_Yamato_BS_TempleChild.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was raised by monks who taught [PAWN_objective] to read the old sutras, sit still for hours and grow herbs in the temple garden.
LanguageData.HE_Yamato_BS_FishingVillage.title: fishing village child
LanguageData.HE_Yamato_BS_FishingVillage.description: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up mending nets and gutting fish on a windy shore, where every family shared its catch.
LanguageData.HE_Yamato_BS_CastleTown.title: castle-town child
LanguageData.HE_Yamato_BS_CastleTown.description: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up in the crowded streets below a lord's castle, running between craftsmen's shops and watching the samurai parade.
